source_en: Vitamin A and Normal Immune Function
headings_en: A Bowl for the Immune Team
Cook the Center All the Way Through
dialogue_en: Carrot, access granted! Today, steamed eggs to help nourish my immune team!
Two eggs, fifty grams of carrot, and one hundred milliliters of water. Just a little salt if you like.
Finely grate the carrot. Small pieces cook tenderly inside the eggs!
Beat the eggs, mix in water and carrot, and pour into a heatproof bowl.
Into the steaming pot, then cover! Cook over medium-low heat for about twelve minutes.
No runny egg in the center! Soft steamed eggs, dotted with carrot, are ready!
Your body can turn the beta-carotene in carrots into vitamin A. Vitamin A is needed for your immune system to work normally.
Eating more doesn't make you invincible! Get the nutrients you need from a variety of foods.
I'll handle the taste inspection. Hmm, I think this needs another inspection. One more bite!

recipe_ko: 1  당근은 씻어 손질한 뒤 곱게 갈아요.
4  김 오른 뒤 중약불로 약 12~15분 쪄요.
가운데에 흐르는 달걀이 남으면 더 익혀요.
recipe_en: Salt optional / use a heatproof bowl
1  Wash, trim and finely grate the carrot.
2  Beat eggs; mix with water and carrot.
3  Cover bowl with a heatproof plate in a steamer.
4  Once steaming, cook on medium-low 12–15 min.
Cook longer if the center still has runny egg.

scenes.title_en: A Bowl for the Immune Team
